title: PROBAHO CRM Solutions
short_summary: A free desktop business system for retail showrooms and distributors that keeps billing and inventory records working when the internet drops. Built with local SQLite WebAssembly storage, automatic update checking, and courier delivery management.
how_it_was_made: Built with AI tools. I designed the product, defined the features, tested and released it.
features: Keeps billing and inventory working when the internet is down
Records who created and last edited each record
Built in courier profiles for Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, Paperfly, Sundarban and eCourier
Backup export saves all data to a single file.

title: Portfolio Optimization and Efficient Frontier Simulation
short_summary: The group evaluated risk, return and covariance relationships across four Dhaka Stock Exchange equities over 250 trading days. The group simulated 34 portfolio weight combinations to construct the Markowitz efficient frontier and identify the optimal Sharpe ratio allocation.
my_role: Responsible for Grameenphone valuation, covariance matrix formulation, and 34 portfolio efficient frontier simulation.

metrics.label: Optimal asset allocation: BRAC Bank, Square, GP (Group result)

title: Equity Research and Valuation Modeling of Square Pharmaceuticals Ltd
short_summary: Prepared an institutional equity research report evaluating market position, financial performance, and capital allocation of Square Pharmaceuticals Ltd. The group built a valuation combining free cash flow to firm, dividend discount models and peer multiples, with five year projections.
my_role: Corporate governance structure, shareholding breakdown, board risk assessment, and long term revenue growth drivers.

title: Valuation Analysis and Industry Research of Bangladesh Pharmaceuticals
short_summary: The group analysed company fundamentals, industry growth trends, and ten year stock return distributions across pharmaceutical firms. The group applied two stage dividend discount models and cash flow methods to compare intrinsic values against prevailing market prices.
my_role: P/E relative valuation for the group's equity research and valuation paper.

metrics.label: Ten year monthly return standard deviation benchmark (Group result)
